subject.title: [Bug]: Trajectory files fed back as context cause unbounded token consumption and unexpected API billing

question: Should maintainers require focused current-main Windows/provider proof before closing this high-impact billing report?
rationale: The reporter provided concrete Gemini and Anthropic billing evidence, while current main has multiple source guardrails but no exact runtime proof of the reported fresh-session path.

options.title: Require focused proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a current-main run proves large trajectory sidecars cannot enter fresh-session model context.

options.title: Close from source guardrails
options.body: Treat the trajectory, memory corpus, TUI session, and bounded reseed guardrails as sufficient and close without reproducing the billing path.

recommendation.title: Require focused proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a current-main run proves large trajectory sidecars cannot enter fresh-session model context.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available routing candidate from current-main source blame and recent transcript-cache ownership.
